IC1: Patients with biopsy-proven [AND] metastatic carcinoid tumors [OR] or other neuroendocrine tumors (Islet cell [OR], Gastrinomas [OR] and VIPomas) [AND] with at least one measurable lesion ([NOT] other than bone) that has either [NOT] not been previously irradiated [OR] or if previously irradiated has demonstrated progression since the radiation therapy
IC2: The patient has [NOT] no major impairment of renal [OR] or hepatic function, as defined by the following laboratory parameters: total bilirubin [OR] <1.5 X ULN; AST, ALT<2.5X ULN [OR] (<5 X ULN [AND] if liver metastases are present)
IC3: Patients on Sandostatin Lar (long acting somatostatin analogue) must be on a stable dose for 30 days prior to study entry and short acting somatostatin analogues must be judged to be on a clinically stable dose by the investigator prior to study entry
IC4: Must have a life expectancy of greater than three (3) months
IC6: Female [AND] patients must have a negative serum pregnancy test at screening [OR]. (Not applicable to patients with bilateral oophorectomy [OR] and/or hysterectomy [OR] or to those patients who are postmenopausal.)
